# PM Dashboard

> A project management dashboard for task tracking and team collaboration.

## Overview

This is a single-page React application that provides task management, user authentication, and team collaboration features. Data is stored in the browser's localStorage.

## Pages

- `/login` - Authentication page with email/password login
- `/` - Dashboard with task statistics (total, pending, in progress, completed, high priority)
- `/tasks` - Task management with search, filter, sort, pagination, and CRUD operations

## API

No external API. All data operations use localStorage directly through a client-side mock service layer.

## Tech Stack

- React 19, TypeScript, Vite
- Material UI v9
- Zustand (auth state)
- TanStack Query (data management)
- React Hook Form + Zod (validation)
